_note: How firmly an owner holds a tile. The set is data: the engine only checks a level is listed here. `rank` orders firmness (higher is firmer).

core.description: the owner's own heartland, governed directly

integrated.description: taken in and administered like the core

enclave.description: a port or post inside land the owner does not govern

claimed.description: named as the owner's but not yet governed there

ungoverned.description: owned on paper with no one governing it

conquest._note: A tile taken by an army is held at `initial`; each step names the level it rises to after the owner has held the tile that many years with an army on it. The years are a labelled heuristic.
conquest.retire: Complaints/484: control from garrison against unrest and distance
